name: cargo-frisk
tagline: Cargo subcommand that diffs your packaged .crate against git to catch leaked secrets before publishing
description: cargo-frisk is a cargo subcommand that catches secrets leaking into the package tarball before you publish to crates.io. Everything in a release tarball is effectively permanent once published, and files that are gitignored locally can still sneak into the .crate. cargo frisk diffs the packaged .crate against git ls-files, then annotates the difference with secret-detection rules so you can spot and fix leaks before they become permanent.
highlights: Diffs packaged .crate contents against git ls-files to surface unexpected files
Catches gitignored secrets that would otherwise ship forever
A cargo-native subcommand that slots into the publish workflow
curatorNote: 'The tarball is what lands on crates.io forever' is the whole pitch, and it is a good one — a tiny tool that prevents a permanent, embarrassing, and security-relevant mistake in the Rust publishing flow.
